notes.title: Update 1.20 released !!!
notes.notes:
Hello Players, 

Version 1.20 is available now!!!

In this update we added something for new and something for experienced Players: 
 - we added 6 new songs. So now it's 21 tracks to play.
 - we fixed the synchronization of some previous songs. 
 - we added new instrument.

FOR NEW PLAYERS:
We received feedback from you that the game is too difficult for the beginners.
So in this update we added easier tracks.
Songs are slower and sequences are more repeatable.

FOR EXPERIENCED PLAYERS.
If you're already playing the game you need new challenges.
We added new instrument, we called it

XYLOPHONE
Hit the key with a stick when the bubble reach the key and his inside fill with color.
Blue and green color is for upper keys, red and orange is for bottom.

notes.title: Update 1.01
notes.notes:
Hello Players, 

Currently we are working  on first update. 
We will add 3-4 new tracks with new genre of music.
We are also planning to add new feature  which adjusts the height of the instruments to growth of Players.

Because it is EA we are open for your suggestions what is good or bad so far.
Maybe you found some bugs or any technical issues which should be solved. 
Each feedbacks and suggestions are taking under the consideration. 
So don't hestitate to write us.

Regards!!
